intro: Alther's Mill is a Redridge Mountains quest given by Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire. The foreman needs adventurers to clear out a dangerous tarantula infestation at the nearby lumber mill so workers can safely retrieve the timber required to finish the Lakeshire bridge.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Orcs, gnolls, murlocs. Everything seems to be out to stop me from getting this bridge done on time. Now we have word there's an infestation of tarantulas at our lumber mill!

If you're up to earn a bit more coin, would you head over to Alther's Mill to the east and clear out their spider problem? Place is as good as useless to me if I can't safely send workers to collect shipments.
Oh, and if you see ol' Alther, tell him he owes me for cleaning up his mess.

clips.title: Progress
paras: A bite from one of the tarantulas out here can leave a worker out with a fever for a week. I'd prefer that didn't happen. At least, not on my watch.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The mill is that bad? That's worse than I thought.
I'm not particularly squeamish, but work's bad enough without spiders snatching up my workers. Thanks for the help, friend!
